Title: Hydroponic Lettuce pH & EC: Targets, ppm & Fixes
Description: Keep hydroponic lettuce at pH 5.5–6.0 and EC 1.2–1.8 (1.0 for seedlings). A pH of 7.0 cost 26% of head weight in a Cornell trial. Fixes inside. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic lettuce ph, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic nutrients
